name: WhatsApp Messenger
description: A free, end-to-end encrypted messaging and calling app used by over 2 billion people worldwide, owned by Meta.
one_liner: World-class encryption on your messages, but WhatsApp feeds your contacts, behavior, and device data into Meta's advertising machine.

name: Instagram
description: A free photo and video sharing app from Meta with feeds, Stories, Reels, and direct messaging, used by over 2 billion people worldwide.
one_liner: Instagram shows you ads using everything it knows about you, including where you go, what you search, and how you behave, and it can read your direct messages.

name: Telegram Messenger
description: A free, cloud-based messaging app focused on speed and security, offering group chats, channels, and optional end-to-end encrypted secret chats.
one_liner: Telegram does not show you ads and does not sell your data, but your regular chats are stored on its servers and only secret chats are truly private.

name: TikTok
description: Users view and explore clips, broadcast in real time, and browse products from merchants. The service delivers a customized viewing stream, simple production utilities, audio and visual enhancements, and numerous preset security settings.
one_liner: TikTok collects a wide range of personal data including your behavior, location, contacts, and device fingerprint, and shares it with advertisers and business partners for targeted ads.

name: Dropbox
description: A cloud storage and file synchronization service that lets you store, share, and access your files from anywhere.
one_liner: Dropbox does not sell your data to advertisers and gives you solid controls to access, download, and delete your files and account.

name: LinkedIn
description: A professional networking platform for connecting with colleagues, finding jobs, sharing industry news, and building your career.
one_liner: LinkedIn shares your professional data with Microsoft, advertisers, and employers, and tracks your behavior across the platform for ad targeting.

name: Canva
description: An all-in-one design platform for creating social media graphics, presentations, posters, videos, and more with AI-powered tools.
one_liner: Canva collects extensive personal data including your designs, location, and device info, uses it for AI training, and shares it with advertisers and vendors.

name: Snapchat
description: A multimedia messaging app known for ephemeral photos and videos, creative filters, and location-based features like Snap Map.
one_liner: Snapchat's disappearing messages are a privacy win, but the app still tracks your location, collects device data, and shares information with partners and advertisers.

name: Hinge
description: A dating app designed to be deleted, focused on fostering serious relationships through detailed profiles and conversation prompts.
one_liner: Hinge collects extremely sensitive personal data including your sexual orientation, health info, racial background, and even your face geometry, then shares it with advertisers and vendors.

name: Bumble
description: A dating and social networking app where women make the first move, offering modes for dating, friendship, and professional networking.
one_liner: Bumble collects sensitive personal data including your biometrics, tracks your behavior and conversations, and shares it with numerous vendors and advertisers.
